integration_notes: Camp construction and finished states share the same 440x440 canvas, uniform scale per pair, and bottom-edge anchor (220,424). Preserve transparent margins.
Weekly stages share 780x240 canvases, uniform scale per sequence, and bottom-edge anchor (390,226). Preserve transparent headroom on early stages.
The 400x160 empty sign is separate from camp building canvas conventions. Game supplies all company, client, rank and newspaper copy; only PAID has baked-in lettering.

All production artwork generated with imagegen. Postprocessing only extracts sheet sprites, excludes adjacent cell fragments, uniformly downsamples, places on transparent canvases and encodes formats.
Herald WebPs are lossless encodings of the delivered JPG decoded pixels. Other WebPs are pixel-identical to their transparent PNGs.
Contact sheet and review sheets are intentionally opaque diagnostic composites, not production sprites.
